snippet.title: NAZA - official trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the official trailer for NAZA, an award-winning documentary produced by the Guardian that details the systems behind Israel’s mass killings in Gaza. 
Subscribe to The Guardian on YouTube ► https://www.youtube.com/user/theguardian?sub_confirmation=1

The critically acclaimed film, produced with the team behind the Zone of Interest and directed by Oscar-winning film-makers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, includes testimony from 24 Israeli military insiders, shot at night on the rooftops of Tel Aviv. Abraham and Szor are the two Israeli directors of the four behind No Other Land, which won the Oscar for best documentary in 2025. It will be released in cinemas in more than 50 countries in the coming weeks, and then will stream on the Guardian’s website, for free, from late November

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Clayface | Final Trailer
snippet.description:
In four weeks, look fear in the face. #ClayfaceMovie - only in theaters October 23.

DC Studios’ “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the cult favorite villain from Gotham’s rogues gallery.

Matt Hagen’s meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss’s actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

The film also stars Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella and Eddie Marsan, as well as Nancy Carroll and Joshua James.

James Watkins directs from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, story by Flanagan, based on characters from DC. The film is produced by Matt Reeves, Lynn Harris, James Gunn and Peter Safran, with Michael E. Uslan, Chantal Nong Vo, Lars P. Winther, Paul Ritchie, Rafi Crohn and Trevor Macy executive producing.

Watkins’ creative team includes director of photography Rob Hardy, production designer James Price, editor Jon Harris and costume designer Keith Madden. Music is by Volker Bertelmann.

DC Studios Presents a 6th & Idaho Production, a James Watkins Film, “Clayface.” The film will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures and released only in theaters in North America on October 23, 2026, and internationally beginning 21 October 2026.

snippet.description:
Cordelia Goode (Sarah Paulson) and Madison Montgomery (Emma Roberts) are working with young witch Ophelia (Avantika) when they're suddenly struck with a terrifying omen... FX’s AHS: 13. Thursdays on FX | Hulu.

#AmericanHorrorStory #AHS #FX

FX’s “American Horror Story,” the global phenomenon that has garnered more than 100 Emmy nominations since its launch in 2011, returns for an unrivaled 13th installment that will do justice to everyone’s most feared number. Bringing together an all-star cast, many of whom are reprising fan favorite roles, “AHS: 13” continues to build on the anthology’s decades-long legacy that has been streamed more than 700 million hours across the globe and spawned a legion of dedicated fans. snippet.description:
Every era eventually meets its challenger. In 2026, VCT saw the beginning of that shift. New contenders have emerged, expectations have been broken, and twice at Masters, a new champion has risen. Now it all comes together in Shanghai, a city where history and the future live side by side. From September 24 to October 18, familiar names, new contenders, and a fearless generation of challengers will compete for the biggest trophy of the year.



Sixteen teams from Americas, CN, EMEA, and Pacific will battle to become the 2026 VALORANT World Champion.



We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: AWS, Coinbase, EWC, ENC, Globant, HyperX, Mastercard, OnePlus, Red Bull, Secretlab, and Verizon.

Lyrics:
There's a quiet where a baby doesn't cry (tranquilo)
There's a hush where a mother might sigh
Mary Mama angel offered her a choice (sereno)
“My son is listening if you got no voice”

Uneasy feeling, I just heard a gunshot (silencio)
There are things you can get used to or not
A thief at large in a carnival of souls
In the silence the devil rock and rolls

Silencio, silencio!
Silencio, silencio!
Where did our love go,
Hey, Jesus of Rio?

It's when I'm with you
I miss you the most
It's when I'm with you
I miss you the most

There's a quiet where you hear the ocean’s roll (tranquilo)
There's a hush where you can hear another soul
Invocation, exaltation is the goal (amigo)
There's a whisper where the mystery unfolds

There's a quiet saying, "Shut your fucking mouth" (silencio)
There's a diet saying, "Spit it fucking out"
Pepper spraying, church is playing crowd control
In the silence is the devil's rock and roll

Silencio, silencio!
Silencio, silencio!
Where did our love go,
Hey, Jesus of Rio?

It's when I'm with you
I miss you the most
It's when I'm with you
I miss you the most

Dressed like a devil but tonight you’re the host
Of Father, Son and the Holy Ghost
Campo de Cristo de silencio (shhh)
Silencio (hey) silencio (hey) silencio (hey!)

snippet.description:

Performed by: Mckenna Grace
Written by: Mckenna Grace, Lauren Isenberg, Sam Jackson Willows 
Produced by: Sam Jackson Willows 

Cast:

Mason Thames: Boy
Gunner Willis: Security Guard

Lyrics: 

[Verse 1] 
I'm jealous of the sun kissing your skin 
I'm jealous of the air that you're breathing in 
I'm jealous of the clothes against your body 
And the words against your lips
When you leave and I'm all alone 
I'm glad you misplaced your cologne 
Right in my nightstand, I'm covered in you 
Waiting, sleeping with your ghost 
Right where you left me

[Chorus] 
I want you to hold me 
And consume me slowly 
So close that our bloodflow’s intertwined 
I want you to need me
My kiss is you breathing 
My touch is the drug without you’ll die 
I, I, I, oh 
I, I, I, oh 
I need you to want me 
I want you to need me, need me, need me

[Verse 2] 
Take me like a pill
Deeper than the thrill 
Fill in every void
Drown out all the noise 
Tell me you would kill
Touch me like I'm silk 
Love me to the point 
I’m the only noise 
Right where you left me

[Chorus] 
I want you to hold me 
And consume me slowly 
So close that our bloodflow's intertwined 
I want you to need me
My kiss is you breathing 
My touch is the drug without you’ll die 
I, I, I, oh
I, I, I, oh 
I need you to want me 
I want you to need me, need me, need me

[Bridge] 
With you I have no control
Need more than you beside me 
I'll carve your name on my bones 
For when they find my body 
The only thing I've ever known is this constant state of longing 
I need you now
I need you whole
I need you to complete me

[Chorus] 
I want you to hold me 
And consume me slowly 
So close that our bloodflow's intertwined 
I want you to need me
My kiss is you breathing 
My touch is the drug without you’ll die 
I, I, I, oh 
I, I, I, oh 
I need you to want me 
I want you to need me, need me, need me

snippet.title: Remy Ma, Keke Wyatt - Why I Get Married?
snippet.description:
The wedding was the dream. The marriage was something else.

In the official video for “Why I Get Married?” featuring Keke Wyatt, Remy Ma takes us through a marriage in four stages: the dream, the darkness, the drowning and finally, the walk away.

From a white wedding dress that turns black, to the loneliness behind closed doors, Remy explores the difference between the marriage everyone sees and the reality a woman may be living privately. As the relationship unravels, the imagery becomes more powerful; drowning, fire and ultimately walking away without looking back.

Keke Wyatt’s powerhouse vocals bring another layer of soul and emotion to a record about love, relationships, growth and that private question so many women have asked themselves: “Why did I get married?”

The lead single from Remy Ma’s upcoming project, Alimony, “Why I Get Married?” sets the tone for what’s to come.

snippet.title: EA Sports FC 27 Review
snippet.description:
EA Sports FC 27 reviewed by Andrew McMahon on PS5 Pro, also available on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.

"EA Sports FC 27 is a game caught between two competing directions. The revamped passing and crossing, deeper Career Mode systems, and greater emphasis on strategy give more meaningful control and reflect the improvements that help build on the series’ strongest foundations. At the same time, those improvements are repeatedly undermined by inconsistent CPU behavior, lingering defensive issues, technical problems, slow menus, and an open-world hub that is disconnected from what fans want from a virtual soccer experience. So while the soccer itself is enjoyable, the series is still searching for the right balance between innovation and making the core game work the way it should."

snippet.title: Ultima Online Retrospective | The Last Hurrah
snippet.description:
Following Pagan's disappointing reception and a mass departure of key talent, Origin Systems was in a holding pattern. The hits were fewer and further between. Relying entirely on Wing Commander to keep the growing company's lights on was an untenable strategy - especially so with the exodus of the series' steward, Chris Roberts. The hour was late, and Origin needed to deliver another mega-hit for their parent company, EA.

Sometimes, when faced with drought, pestilence, and rotten soil, a pioneer has no choice but to seek greener pastures. In the mid-1990s, network multiplayer represented fertile ground indeed.

From its unlikely formation at the behest of Richard Garriott and Starr Long, to its tempering at the hands of Raph Koster and his team of Multi-User Dungeon enthusiasts, to its changing identity in the face of competition, to its incalculable influence, this is the story of Ultima Online.

https://www.patreon.com/majuular
https://www.youtube.com/@Majuularcade (2nd channel)

You'd be honoring Spleen by joining In Mani Ylem here:
https://uo.mysterious-castle.com/
(Thanks to Eclectocrat for creating this website!)

Thank you to Alexey Gorboot for designing the thumbnail to this video! Alexey can be found here:
https://x.com/AlexeyGorboot

Thanks to Dave Ward for providing a cover of the Might & Magic 6 town music. More of his music can be found here:
https://open.spotify.com/artist/3TKIvrgHCgrG1X7HL0pA40?si=O0JcySQ6RZG1Do7zXhwsEQ

This is the 13th video in my Ultima Retrospective series. Watching earlier parts isn't necessary to enjoy this video, but it is recommended. They can be found here:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL16yfJJxAM6g-4YxKGI-17q-K3nrXuVSd&si=9ugOb5fncTRdmUdE
